reason: Provides DSH tools for automating an iOS simulator through WebDriverAgent and simctl, including screenshots, UI inspection, tapping, URL launching, and privacy preauthorization.

summaries.zh: 通过 WebDriverAgent 和 simctl 提供用于自动化操控 iOS 模拟器的截图、元素查找、点击、可访问性检查、URL 打开和隐私预授权工具。
summaries.en: Provides DSH tools to automate an iOS simulator through WebDriverAgent and simctl, including screenshots, element lookup, tapping, accessibility inspection, URL launching, and privacy preauthorization.

capabilities: Start and monitor WebDriverAgent on an iOS simulator
Find and tap UI elements or coordinates
Export the foreground app accessibility tree
Open URLs and custom schemes in the simulator
